title: ProtoSemImage: Image-Valued Prototypes with Deformable Row Alignment for Interpretable Document Classification
abstract: arXiv:2610.11460v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Prototypes in classification models are almost always vectors, and a vector has no readable form. This paper asks what happens when a prototype is an image. Documents give the question a natural form, because a document can be rendered as a multi-channel image in which every token becomes a pixel, so a class representative can take the same shape and the same channel semantics as the inputs it stands for. ProtoSemImage represents each class by one or more visual archetypes: prototype images in a four-channel HSV space whose channels carry named linguistic factors. A Skip-Gram objective learns that color space end to end through a four-dimensional bottleneck, discourse boundary rows become differentiable typed difference rows, and classification reduces to 2D visual template matching: a deformable row alignment between a document image and the archetype bank, in the spirit of dynamic time warping. Because the match is a spatial pattern

translated_title: ProtoSemImage：基于可变形行对齐的图像值原型用于可解释文档分类
translated_abstract: 分类模型中的原型几乎总是向量，而向量没有可读的形式。本文探讨了当原型是一幅图像时会发生什么。文档为这个问题提供了自然的形式，因为文档可以渲染为多通道图像，其中每个词元都成为一个像素，因此类别代表可以采用与其所代表的输入相同的形状和通道语义。ProtoSemImage 用一个或多个视觉原型来表示每个类别：即四通道 HSV 空间中的原型图像，其通道承载着命名的语言因素。Skip-Gram 目标通过一个四维瓶颈端到端地学习该颜色空间，语篇边界行变为可微分的类型化差异行，而分类则简化为二维视觉模板匹配：即文档图像与原型库之间的可变形行对齐，其思想类似于动态时间规整。由于匹配是一种空间模式
tldr: 该论文提出 ProtoSemImage，将类别原型表示为四通道 HSV 空间中通道承载语言因素的可读原型图像（每个词元对应一个像素），并通过类似动态时间规整的可变形行对齐把文档分类简化为二维视觉模板匹配，从而实现可解释的文档分类。
en_tdlr: ProtoSemImage represents class prototypes as readable four-channel HSV prototype images whose channels carry named linguistic factors, and reduces document classification to 2D visual template matching via deformable row alignment akin to dynamic time warping, enabling interpretable document classification.
